description: The employer's leads (people it added from its own forms and ads), each with its job and whether that person has applied to it (same job, same email) with the application's stage. applied=true lists those who applied, newest application first; applied=false those who have not. Contact details are the ones the employer typed when adding the lead; an application's own email, phone or CV is never returned.

applied.description: true = only leads who applied; false = only leads who have not.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).

name: list_leads
title: Leads and who applied
